summary: John's 2nd cousin 9x removed; builder of the Joshua Smith House at Hauppauge.
bio: Wood: house built 'about 1769, not far west of Thomas Wheeler's' (the old store/post office corner); the 1968 Rockwell scrapbook dates it 'circa 1761 or possibly earlier', a salt-box; he married in October 1761 (Pelletreau App. p. 478). A photo caption in John's Drive: 'built c. 1761, remodeled in 1819, demolished in 1960. Hall woodwork now at the Henry Francis duPont Winterthur Museum'. Four generations lived there: Joshua I, Judge Joshua II, Sen. Joshua B., Ellen. No Find a Grave memorial found for him.
